An arXiv technical report by Hongcheng Gao, Jingjing Zhou, and colleagues says HexaAnything raised RoboCasa365 Composite-Unseen success from 34.3% with XR-1 alone to 38.3% using the same policy inside its planning-and-verification harness.

On an AgileX dual-arm robot, Gao, Zhou, and coauthors report that five of seven tabletop tasks succeeded in all three trials; the report calls the evidence preliminary and says longer-horizon tasks remain untested.
